description: How a wallet's balance in one USDC Account, Bitcoin Account, Ethereum Account or MAMO Account moved over the last 1 to 60 days: a daily series plus the change in tokens, dollars and percent. For "how much have I made?". No Account of that kind returns an empty series, not an error.

address.description: The wallet address that owns the Account, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

days.description: How far back to look, 1-60 days. Default 30.

name: get_balance_history
title: An Account's balance over time
